title: Tense and Passive Voice in Science
objective: Students use present tense for facts and past/passive forms for methods.
context: Class notes: Birds lay eggs. Yesterday, students counted birds in three trees.

items.prompt: Copy the general fact. Name its tense.
items.hint: Find the sentence that is generally true.

items.prompt: Copy the completed action. Name its tense.
items.answer: Yesterday, students counted birds in three trees. Past simple.

items.prompt: Rewrite the completed action in the passive voice.
items.answer: Birds in three trees were counted yesterday. Accept an optional by-phrase.
items.hint: Use were and the past participle.
